'''Colim''' was an individual, who worked as poacher for [[Rufus Trammel]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Dorumaa]], during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After Trammel's poachers captured the [[Dorumaan leviathan]] [[Jessel]], the poacher [[Parx]] asked Colim if some of the other poachers were ready to load the creature onto Trammel's [[Starship/Legends|starship]].
